provenance: RQ01 designed research policy; no claim of empirically representative retail frequencies. Catalog names are design inputs, not verified provider coverage or live listings.

price_move.description: Explain or verify the causes of a market price move

variants.spot_derivatives: Distinguish spot flow from derivatives/liquidation explanations
variants.relative_divergence: Explain why two assets moved differently
variants.macro_channel: Assess how rates/currency/macro news could transmit into price
variants.reversal: Explain a reversal or a failed breakout
variants.premise_check: Verify that the claimed move happened before explaining it

news.description: Retrieve and assess recent asset news, not price analysis

variants.incident: Check for recent incidents, outages or operational problems
variants.listing_access: Find recent listings, trading-access or fund changes
variants.rumor_check: Verify a circulating news rumor against primary sources
variants.freshness: Separate genuinely new reporting from recycled news

full_analysis.description: Integrate multiple market signals into an asset assessment

variants.signal_integration: Combine trend, volume and other independent signals
variants.signal_conflict: Reconcile contradictory signals rather than picking one blindly
variants.liquidity_context: Combine liquidity, trading activity and recent news
variants.bull_bear_case: Present evidence for competing bullish and bearish cases
variants.trend_catalyst: Combine current trend with possible future catalysts
variants.change_since: Explain what changed across several signals since an earlier time
variants.weekly_outlook: Combine the past week’s performance with a conditional next-week setup

relative_strength.description: Rank a supplied universe by relative performance

variants.benchmark_return: Rank supplied assets by return relative to a named benchmark
variants.two_windows: Compare rankings across two lookback windows
variants.drawdown_adjusted: Rank relative performance while considering drawdown
variants.risk_adjusted: Rank performance after accounting for volatility
variants.sector_comparison: Rank supplied sector/fund proxies against a benchmark
variants.trend_consistency: Rank how consistently assets outperformed a benchmark

event_study.description: Compare observed historical responses to past events

variants.macro_repeats: Compare returns after several past macro releases
variants.intraday_daily: Compare initial and next-day reactions to past releases
variants.cross_asset: Compare two assets after the same historical events
variants.drawdown: Compare post-event drawdowns across historical occurrences
variants.reversal_frequency: Count how often the initial historical reaction reversed
variants.anticipation_reaction: Compare pre-event and post-event historical returns

theme_exposure.description: Find and compare instruments expressing an investment theme

variants.direct_indirect: Compare direct and indirect ways to express a theme
variants.single_basket: Compare single-name exposure with a basket
variants.pure_diversified: Compare focused and diversified thematic exposure
variants.cost_access: Compare access, fees and trading constraints for a theme
variants.proxy_quality: Assess whether an available proxy really tracks the thesis
variants.liquidity_tradeoff: Compare thematic exposure with liquidity/concentration tradeoffs

allocate_capital.description: Choose purchases or staged deployment of new capital

variants.single_choice: Choose among assets for a fresh budget
variants.staged_entry: Compare deploying a fresh budget now versus in stages
variants.concentration: Allocate new capital while limiting concentration
variants.holding_horizon: Allocate fresh capital for a stated holding period
variants.alternatives: Compare explicit alternatives for a new purchase
variants.risk_preference: Allocate new capital under a stated loss/risk preference

manage_position.description: Hold, trim, exit or reallocate an explicitly owned position

variants.hold_exit: Compare holding an owned position with exiting it
variants.trim_all: Compare trimming an owned position with a full exit
variants.unrealized_loss: Decide what to do with an owned losing position
variants.unrealized_gain: Decide what to do with an owned profitable position
variants.reallocate: Compare keeping an owned position with reallocating it
variants.decision_trigger: Identify evidence that would change a hold/sell decision

short_setup.description: Identify or compare potential short setups

variants.invalidation: Find a short idea with a clear invalidation condition
variants.compare_candidates: Compare two candidate shorts with entry conditions
variants.crowding_cost: Find a short while considering crowding/funding/borrow costs
variants.short_horizon: Find a short for a specified short holding period
variants.relative_weakness: Find a weak asset against a stronger benchmark
variants.liquidity: Find a short with sufficient liquidity and feasible execution

catalyst_entry.description: Decide whether to buy or wait ahead of a conditional prospective catalyst

variants.priced_in: Assess whether a possible catalyst is already priced in
variants.buy_wait: Compare buying before a possible event with waiting
variants.event_confirmation: Make an entry decision conditional on confirming an event
variants.sell_news: Assess risk of buying ahead of a possible sell-the-news reaction
variants.delay_failure: Assess entry risk if a prospective event is delayed or fails
variants.alternative_exposure: Compare ways to enter around the same possible catalyst

risk_sizing.description: Calculate or assess position size under explicit loss constraints

variants.stop_budget: Size a position from a hypothetical loss budget and stop distance
variants.volatility_size: Compare position sizes under different volatility assumptions
variants.concentration_cap: Size an addition under a portfolio concentration cap
variants.leverage_margin: Assess leverage/margin limits for a hypothetical trade
variants.gap_risk: Assess how gap/slippage risk changes a nominal stop-based size

execution_cost.description: Assess implementation costs for a hypothetical order

variants.market_limit: Compare market and limit order tradeoffs
variants.slippage_depth: Estimate possible slippage from available depth
variants.fees_total: Compare total trading costs including fees and spread
variants.slice_order: Compare a single order with sliced execution
variants.venue_cost: Compare execution cost across available venues
variants.illiquid_period: Assess execution risk when trading activity is thin

portfolio_risk.description: Assess joint exposures and concentration of a supplied portfolio

variants.concentration: Find common exposures hidden behind several holdings
variants.stress: Assess portfolio impact of a hypothetical market shock
variants.hedge: Compare ways to reduce a specified portfolio exposure
variants.rebalance: Compare rebalancing alternatives against a stated objective
variants.liquidity: Assess portfolio liquidity under a hypothetical exit need

source_verification.description: Assess truth, provenance, time or comparability of a market claim

variants.primary_source: Verify a quoted market claim against primary sources
variants.timestamp: Check whether cited data are stale or time-mismatched
variants.definitions: Resolve conflicting numbers with different metric definitions
variants.venue_identity: Check that a claim refers to the same market/instrument/venue
variants.causal_claim: Distinguish an asserted cause from mere correlation
variants.cherry_picking: Check whether a performance claim cherry-picks its comparison window

instrument_mechanics.description: Apply instrument mechanics to a concrete retail situation

variants.carrying_cost: Explain carrying/funding/financing cost for a hypothetical position
variants.settlement: Explain settlement or cash-flow mechanics for a hypothetical position
variants.tracking: Explain why an instrument may differ from its underlying exposure
variants.leverage_payoff: Explain leveraged versus unleveraged hypothetical payoff
variants.liquidity_access: Explain how instrument access/liquidity affects a hypothetical choice
variants.structural_risk: Explain product-specific risks for a concrete holding choice

scenario_analysis.description: Reason conditionally about a hypothetical future market state

variants.rate_shock: Assess effects of a hypothetical rate surprise
variants.risk_off: Compare exposures under a hypothetical risk-off move
variants.liquidity_shock: Assess effects of a hypothetical liquidity squeeze
variants.currency_move: Assess effects of a hypothetical currency move
variants.catalyst_failure: Compare outcomes if a hypothetical catalyst succeeds or fails
variants.counterfactual: Compare two explicit hypothetical market paths

token_due_diligence.description: Assess an onchain token identity, trading health and specific risks

variants.identity_drivers: Resolve token identity and explain what might drive trading
variants.trading_status: Check whether trading/project activity continues or failed
variants.holder_distribution: Assess holder concentration together with volume/trading health
variants.rug_risk: Investigate rug/manipulation risk using onchain evidence
variants.entry_risk: Assess whether an onchain token is worth entering given risks
variants.exit_liquidity: Assess ability to exit an onchain token without assuming liquidity

derivatives_positioning.description: Assess derivatives positioning rather than merely quote a price

variants.funding_crowding: Use funding to assess whether longs or shorts are crowded
variants.open_interest: Assess changes in open interest and what they imply
variants.price_oi: Interpret price and open-interest changes jointly
variants.liquidation_risk: Assess liquidation/crowding risk from derivatives evidence

technical_setup.description: Assess a concrete technical trading setup or risk level

variants.breakout: Check whether a potential breakout is confirmed
variants.extension: Assess whether a move is overextended
variants.stop_invalidation: Choose a defensible stop/invalidation for a hypothetical trade
variants.entry_trigger: Identify evidence needed to trigger an entry
variants.scenario_levels: Compare alternative price scenarios and relevant levels

fund_flows.description: Measure or explain fund/institutional capital flows, not token trading volume

variants.etf_net: Report aggregate ETF net inflows/outflows for an asset
variants.daily_weekly: Compare daily and weekly ETF flow patterns
variants.flow_price: Compare fund flows with underlying price behavior
variants.source_reconcile: Reconcile fund-flow reports and their timestamps

relative_value.description: Compare linked asset values, ratios, spreads or an asset backing premium

variants.precious_ratio: Assess the gold/silver ratio and relative-value implications
variants.crude_spread: Assess the Brent-WTI spread and its interpretation
variants.asset_nav: Compare an equity value with reported underlying asset holdings/NAV
variants.relative_expensiveness: Assess whether one linked asset looks expensive versus another
variants.historical_range: Compare a ratio/spread/premium with its own history
variants.drivers: Explain what could account for a ratio/spread/premium

event_outlook.description: Assess a relevant event calendar, expectations and market implications

variants.calendar_consensus: Find the next issuer earnings date and expected results
variants.news_reaction: Relate supply/producer-policy news to a commodity reaction
variants.weather: Assess weather-linked catalysts for natural gas
variants.supply_demand: Assess supply/demand events relevant to a commodity outlook
variants.event_risk: Compare possible event outcomes without claiming a schedule
variants.expectations: Separate event expectations from an already observed outcome

trade_selection.description: Choose among prospective longs without assuming a fresh capital budget

variants.risk_reward: Identify an attractive long after comparing risk/reward
variants.timing: Compare entering a long now versus waiting
variants.liquidity_filter: Choose a possible long while accounting for liquidity
variants.thematic_selection: Choose a long consistent with an investment theme
variants.invalidation: Choose a potential long with a clear invalidation condition

book_depth.description: Request concrete visible order-book/depth information, not a price-cause explanation

variants.top_levels: Show top bid and ask price levels with displayed sizes
variants.price_band: Show displayed depth within a price band
variants.imbalance: Compare displayed bid and ask depth
variants.venues: Compare visible depth across named venues
variants.spread_levels: Show spread together with nearby levels
variants.order_capacity: Assess displayed depth for a hypothetical order size

variants.bull_bear: Compare bullish and bearish public narratives
variants.narrative_change: Compare how public discussion changed over time
variants.disagreement: Identify what public participants disagree about
variants.credibility: Assess sources behind a public narrative
variants.cross_asset: Compare public narratives for two assets

four_category_reference.description: Equal coverage of all 32 user-supplied intent cells, eight per category; compatible randomized variation within each cell.

four_category_explore.description: Equal category mass; randomized selection from additional compatible retail tasks. Reference intent cells remain the starting vocabulary, not mandatory fixed quotas.

retry_policy: resample compatible subordinate axes while preserving source intent, task and category; retain every revision
format_policy: deterministic short format suffix only when absent; raw model text retained
calibration_note: A single-background diagnostic preserved premise/form labels but changed the parent task for four of twelve outputs. Production mode constraints narrowed accordingly; the narrowing has offline tests, not a fresh paid full-bank validation.
